decisions.amendment: R4 protocol v1 amendment 2 (N-A2, AMB-29(a)-(d), AMB-30, AMB-31, AMB-32, I-1 to I-6), candidate rev12
decisions.N_A2_applicability: protocol 9 QS-vs-dynamic applies to a pair only if both the B0 and the B3 profile pass the QS feasibility screen (QSPlant.step) on the condition's evaluated plant
decisions.N_A2_applicable_failure: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE (protocol 9, unchanged)
decisions.N_A2_no_eligible_comparison: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE with respect to this criterion
decisions.N_A2_failed_check_record: every failing piece with its failed QSPlant.step sub-check(s) (drive torque, battery discriminant, discharge current) and their values at each Gauss node; if that diagnosis raises, the piece says so and the exception is recorded in errors.csv (stage qs_screen, review R9-1)
decisions.AMB_29_profile_unavailable: owner ruling 2026-10-28: the condition keeps its explicit PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE or BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE status and counts in every planned-run, feasibility and verdict denominator; never COMPARABLE, never a paired comparison, never removed; only the pair's QS-vs-dynamic check is NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE (its applicability condition is objectively unmet), which is not a pass
decisions.AMB_29_eligible_run_missing: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(b)): NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING (class NOT_EVALUABLE) -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the pair stays in every planned-run denominator and every available energy trace is kept for diagnostics
decisions.AMB_29_qs_energy_undefined: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(c)): QS energy per reference km <= 0 -> NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the raw values and the exact non-positive term are recorded; no percentage, replacement denominator, epsilon, absolute value or substitute threshold; the runs' dynamic result is unaffected and protocol 8.2 still applies to it. Owner ruling I-5 (2026-10-28): the label NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED is kept unchanged; the owner's QS_COMPARISON_NOT_EVALUABLE is the NOT_EVALUABLE class
decisions.AMB_29_condition_error: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(d)): an exception before or during the pair evaluation, including the QS screen -> NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; both dynamic arms still run and are classified by protocol 8.2 alone; the error, stage, traceback, traces and run IDs are kept (errors.csv, conditions/, traces/); no retry, automatic replacement or substitute run; a rerun only under the protocol and an explicitly authorised procedure with a distinct run ID. Owner ruling I-6 (2026-10-28): if a run or evaluation raises an exception, the pair becomes NOT_EVALUABLE even if its QS check would otherwise be NOT_APPLICABLE; the exception, stage, affected run ID and process log are kept; no silent retry or replacement; NOT_APPLICABLE never overrides an execution error; QS applicability (qs_vs_dyn_applicability), dynamic validity (the condition status) and the evaluation status (qs_vs_dyn_pair_status) are kept separate. Owner decision I-6b (2026-10-29): a QS-eligible pair one of whose runs was attempted and raised an exception is NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR, not NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING; a genuinely absent run energy (an executed run without a finite simulator energy, no exception) stays NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING (AMB-29(b)). Owner decision (2026-10-29) on a failure of the separate recomputation or its fold: only a NOT_APPLICABLE_* pair with an actually executed run becomes NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR; a pair none of whose runs was executed keeps its NOT_APPLICABLE_* label. As applied under these rulings: a pair with an exception whose label would otherwise be NOT_APPLICABLE_*, PASS, REPORTED_ONLY or FAIL is NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR, except that after a failure of the separate recomputation or its fold a PASS, FAIL or REPORTED_ONLY that used energy the separate recomputation did not confirm is NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID (AMB-31, I-4); NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING (AMB-29(b)), NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED (AMB-29(c)) and NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID (AMB-31) remain applicable under their own rules; no pair becomes NOT_APPLICABLE_* or PASS after an exception; the label before the exception rule is kept in qs_vs_dyn_pair_status_before_error, a measured failure in qs_vs_dyn_fail_arms and in the accounting (fail_before_exception, n_FAIL_before_exception). Implementer reading (not an owner ruling), for the owner's confirmation: (a) every recorded stage of a pair (run, run_report, qs_screen with its per-piece diagnosis, classify, qs_vs_dynamic, condition_report, condition) counts as a run or its evaluation; (b) after an exception at a stage other than one of its runs, a pair already NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING, NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED or NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID keeps that label
decisions.AMB_30_branch_scope: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (strict): an applicable FAIL or a NOT_EVALUABLE_* pair in any preregistered set (NOM, P3, INS, CNV, SEN) makes the M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE, counted per set, never averaged; a PASS in another set, the in-sample S1 set INS included, never substitutes for missing or failed nominal S2 evidence; a planned pair missing from the record blocks PASS. Owner ruling I-1 (2026-10-28): every required nominal cell of the branch (NOM; L-R1 and L-EVE) must individually PASS; an absent, duplicated, invalid, not-evaluable or NOT_APPLICABLE_* nominal cell, or one whose condition has no profile, cannot count as PASS and the branch is INCONCLUSIVE; a FAIL keeps the frozen protocol 9 consequence. Owner ruling I-2 (2026-10-28): outside NOM a missing profile (NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE) does not by itself make the QS check INCONCLUSIVE; it is never a PASS; the explicit missing-profile status stays counted in the planned-run and feasibility reporting and never yields a paired energy comparison
decisions.I_1_required_nominal_cells: owner ruling 2026-10-28: for M0 and M1 every required nominal cell on the held-out S2 set (NOM; L-R1 and L-EVE) must individually PASS the applicable QS-vs-dynamic check; a missing, invalid, unevaluable or NOT_APPLICABLE required nominal cell cannot count as PASS and the branch is INCONCLUSIVE; S1 never substitutes; a FAIL keeps the frozen consequence; thresholds unchanged; QS and dynamic feasibility stay distinct (a QS-infeasible profile is never reclassified as dynamically infeasible)
decisions.AMB_31_energy_of_invalid_runs: owner ruling 2026-10-28: energy of a run failing protocol 8.2, or not confirmed by its recomputation, is diagnostic only (energy_roles.csv DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_*): never confirmatory, never credited to the paired endpoint, never used by the QS-vs-dynamic check. Owner ruling I-4 (2026-10-28): both runs must be confirmed by the separate recomputation (and by the in-process one) before the QS check uses their energy; an unconfirmed run supplies no confirmatory evidence for that check
decisions.AMB_31_invalid_arm_label: NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID (owner ruling AMB-29(b): M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE; M2 stays reported only)
decisions.paired_endpoint_rule: a paired energy comparison exists only for a condition whose final status is COMPARABLE: both arms complete the task and pass every protocol 8.2 criterion and the separate recomputation
decisions.h3_verdict_denominators: fixed by protocol 8.1: 6 nominal S2 P1 cells and 32 draws per M0/M1; a missing, profile-failed, invalid or non-comparable cell or draw is never removed and never counts toward SUPPORTED
decisions.AMB_32_not_supported_needs_all_nominal_c: owner ruling 2026-10-28: NOT SUPPORTED requires a comparable pair in all six nominal cells; a nominal cell that is missing, invalid or not evaluable makes the H3 verdict INCONCLUSIVE, recorded with its reason; no negative finding is inferred from missing data
decisions.qs_dynamic_accounting_classes: review R8-2, owner ruling I-6: every row of qs_dynamic_accounting.csv adds up to its planned pairs two separate ways: by QS applicability (qs_eligible_pairs, qs_ineligible_pairs, not_applicable_profile_unavailable, qs_eligibility_unknown) and by pair status (qs_check_pass, qs_check_fail, qs_check_reported_only, qs_check_not_applicable_qs_infeasible, qs_check_not_applicable_profile_unavailable and the four not_evaluable_* columns); a pair made NOT_EVALUABLE by an exception stays in its applicability class
decisions.non_positive_denominator_rule: AMB-29(c) and owner ruling I-3 (2026-10-28), for every energy-saving percentage, the QS-vs-dynamic ratio (e_QS) and the others (paired dE_rel, B0 energy per reference km; planner S_found, S_max and grid dS, E(v_b)): none is computed with a denominator <= 0 or not finite; the value is not evaluable and the exact term and the raw values are recorded. The recomputation and shortfall tolerance comparisons of amendment 1 are not saving percentages and are unchanged
decisions.record_invariant: every scheduled condition and run has exactly one record (no drop, retry or replacement); a violation is recorded in errors.csv and the manifest
decisions.separate_recomputation_exit_codes: 0 every recomputed run passes; 1 a run fails a protocol check; 3 independence violation or refusal; 4 exception, including one while importing or reading the arguments. Only 0 and 1 are results: any other exit leaves every run unconfirmed and is recorded in errors.csv with its stderr; a fold that raises leaves no condition COMPARABLE
decisions.separate_recomputation_ledger: reviews V6-1, R7-4: the process's full output goes to recomputation_independent_process.log; a launch failure, an exit other than 0 or 1, a missing or unreadable output file, or an executed run missing from the output is recorded in errors.csv with its stage and that log; every executed run the separate recomputation does not confirm as recomputed (all of them after a process failure) gets its own row with its run ID
decisions.errors_ledger: reviews R7-3, R7-5, R8-5: every errors.csv row has a stage; diagnostic_path where a process log exists; every failed output write (each conditions/<id>.json, conditions.csv and the process log included) is recorded with stage 'write <file>' and listed in manifest output_write_failures, and the remaining outputs are still written; a failed planner-file write during a condition is a condition-level exception; a failed errors.csv write is recorded in the manifest; a failed manifest or post-run hash-list write stops the run with an error
